translation.title: Benzoyl Peroxide Gel
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for acne vulgaris (common acne).
translation.usage: Wash the affected area clean, then apply the gel, usually 1 to 2 times a day, patting it in gently. When starting treatment, apply once a day (at bedtime); once your skin has adapted well, increase to twice a day (morning and evening).
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you have inflammation, if you are or have been hypersensitive to it, on skin that already showed irritation during preliminary treatment, or on wounds or pre-existing skin lesions. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have dry or oily atopic skin or eroded (raw) skin, if you are or have been hypersensitive to propylene glycol, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Do not use it together with other therapeutic topical keratolytic (skin-peeling) agents or cleansers. Use a mild facial cleanser (wash your face at most twice a day) and do not use cosmetics containing perfume or alcohol. At the start of and during treatment, it is advisable to avoid exposure to sunlight and use a sunscreen product. Do not use UV lamps. Take particular care if you have a fair complexion or on areas where the skin is delicate. This medicine is for external use only. Be careful not to let it touch the eyes, nose, mouth or other mucous membranes; if it gets into the eyes, rinse them completely with plenty of water. Do not use it together with other topical acne medicines (including acne medicines containing vitamin A derivatives). If severe or persistent irritation occurs, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Contact dermatitis, allergic contact dermatitis, severe erythema that leaves scars, temporary swelling of the face, dermatitis, skin rash, irritation early in treatment (such as a mild burning sensation), redness or peeling later in treatment, bleaching of hair and colored fabrics, and increased sensitivity to sunlight can occur. Sudden dryness and peeling of the skin can appear after 1 to 2 weeks, but this peeling is a normal part of treatment and lessens within 1 to 2 days if treatment is paused. Store at room temperature and keep out of reach of children.
